verdict.rationale: Firebase's first-party docs name several official SDKs: the Firebase Authentication SDK with sign-in methods, the Admin SDK as a Cloud Functions trigger source, and the Firebase Test SDK for Node.js unit tests. They also cover the drop-in FirebaseUI library and client-side Firestore offline caching. A community user corroborates that Firebase's libraries 'come for free'. missing for 10: an explicit list of SDK languages/platforms, SDK reference documentation in the evidence, and hands-on corroboration of SDK quality for AI-native workflows.
